The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 22. Warranty Successful bidder will have to ensure that adequate number of dedicated technical service personals / engineers are designated / deployed for attending to the Service Request in a time bound manner and for ensuring Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period, as per Service level agreement indicated in the relevant clause of the bid.
